title: Welcome to the Token Engineering Commons Forum!

posts.cooked:
Welcome to the TEC forum! This is a space for our community to discuss, collaborate, and drive the future of token engineering. Below, you’ll find essential information about the TEC, how to get involved, and key resources.

What is the TEC?

The Token Engineering Commons (TEC) is a community-governed decentralized autonomous organization (DAO) dedicated to advancing the field of token engineering to enable the creation of new economic realities.

     What is Token Engineering? - to·ken en·gi·neer·ing /ˈtōkən/ /enjəˈniriNG/

  • Token engineering is the interdisciplinary process of designing, verifying, and optimizing token-based systems through the integration of engineering and system design principles, cryptography, economics, and computer science to create trustworthy, efficient, and sustainable token-based economies.

     What is a Commons? - com·mons /ˈkämənz/

  • A commons is a shared resource accessible to all community members, requiring collective stewardship to prevent overuse and ensure sustainable and equitable access for both current and future generations.

Vision

Enable the creation of ethical, safe, resilient, and diverse economic systems to benefit societies around the world.

Mission

Our goal is to become a schelling point for the token engineering community.

  • Economic Layer: Fund projects that discover, develop, and proliferate best practices for engineering safe tokenized economies, while aligning our collective success with the individual benefit of token holders.
  • Social Layer: Unite the token engineering field around ethical principles, standards, tools, and methodologies as this nascent field advances.

Values

Our Commons operates from a prosocial, human-centered perspective and prioritizes the advancement of token engineering over short-term profits.

  • Integrity, curiosity, constructive inquiry, presence, and gratitude are foundational for maintaining mutual respect within our growing community.
  • We encourage our members to be radically open source, non-hierarchical, transparent in their intentions, and accountable for their actions.

Governance and Community

Community Covenant

Outlines the principles and values that guide our interactions and collaborations within the TEC. It emphasizes respect, inclusion, and a commitment to ethical conduct. Adhering to this covenant ensures that our community remains welcoming, supportive, and focused on our shared goals.

Code of Conduct

Outlines the expected behavior and guidelines for maintaining a respectful and productive community environment. It ensures that all members feel safe and valued while participating in TEC activities.

Polycentric Governance Framework

Promotes decentralized decision-making and collective management of our resources. This innovative approach ensures that all community members have a voice in shaping the future of the TEC, fostering a more resilient and inclusive community.

How to Get Involved

We are constantly looking for ways to expand how the community can get involved. Here are some key ways in which you can start contributing:

1. Governance

The $TEC token is at the heart of our mission. By holding TEC tokens, you can vote on proposals to help shape the direction of the TEC as well as to have a greater impact on our grants program through Tunable Quadratic Funding (TQF).

  • Participate in Governance Voting:

    • Onchain Voting: Engage in our onchain voting processes to influence important decisions. Join here.
    • Offchain Voting: Express your opinions and vote on proposals through Snapshot. Participate here.

  • Learn more about the TEC token.

2. TE Grants Programs

You can contribute to the TEC by submitting a project and generating impact through our grants programs. Our grants portal is the gateway to discovering opportunities to support innovative projects that align with our mission.
Visit the Grants Program Portal.

3. TEC Job Board

Become an active contributor by exploring the open roles we have at the TEC. Our job board lists current opportunities to join our team and contribute to the advancement of token engineering.
Check the Job Board.

Other Resources

  • History of the TEC: Discover the journey of the TEC, from its inception to the present, and understand the milestones that have shaped our community. Read our history.

  • Handbook: Our handbook provides comprehensive information about the TEC, including our mission, values, operational procedures, and community guidelines. Read the Handbook.

Stay Connected

  • X: Follow us on X for real-time updates, news, and community highlights. Follow @tecmns.

  • Discord: Join our Discord community to connect with other members and participate in discussions. Join our Discord.

  • Medium: Stay updated with our latest articles, insights, and stories from the TEC community. Visit our Medium.

We encourage you to dive in, explore the resources, and start contributing to discussions. Your participation is vital to the growth and success of our community.

Feel free to ask any questions or suggest additional resources that might be helpful. We’re here to support each other and advance the field of token engineering together. Welcome to the TEC!
